hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ ، وَسُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ " يَنْهَيَانِ أَنْ يَبِيعَ الرَّجُلُ حِنْطَةً بِذَهَبٍ إِلَى أَجَلٍ ، ثُمَّ يَشْتَرِيَ بِالذَّهَبِ تَمْرًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْبِضَ الذَّهَبَ "

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated that Kathir ibn Farqad asked Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm about a man who sells food to a man for gold on credit, then buys dates with the gold before he receives the gold, so he disliked that and forbade it. And it was narrated from Ibn Shihab with similar meaning. Malik said: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, Sulayman ibn Yasar, Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm, and Ibn Shihab only forbade that a man should not sell wheat for gold, then the man buys dates with the gold before he receives the gold from his sale from the one from whom he bought the wheat. But as for buying dates with the gold with which he sold the wheat on credit from someone other than the seller from whom he bought the wheat, before receiving the gold and transferring the one from whom he bought the dates to his debtor who sold him the wheat for the gold that he owes him as the price of the dates, there is no harm in that. Malik said: I asked more than one of the people of knowledge about that, and they saw no harm in it.

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated that Muhammad ibn Sirin used to say: Do not sell grain in its ears until it whitens. Malik said: Whoever buys food at a known price to a specified term, then when the term comes due, the seller asks him to wait with the food, he should not wait for him unless he collects his price from him. If he waits for him with the food after paying him its price, there is no harm in that. But if he waits for him with the food before collecting its price, then he is selling food on credit before receiving it, and that is not permissible. [Followed by Malik's commentary on delaying payment and its implications]

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ كَانَ " يَنْهَى عَنِ الْحُكْرَةِ "
